_meta.description: Product-intent confirmation record. For each submitted link: the intended ASIN and the official listing URL the site publishes, the date and source of that confirmation, and the observed redirect target recorded in a separate field. The two are never merged. The short-link path codes are not ASINs.
_meta.carried_from: data/imported/zone4/z4-intent.json (confirmed 2026-11-17 there; ASIN format rule per Amazon's published ASIN guide, source S-ASIN)
_meta.fields_rule: intended_asin and observed_redirect are separate fields with separate dates. They are never merged or averaged.
